project_type: Laravel 13 e-commerce storefront + admin panel, monorepo (single Laravel app)
build_system: Vite (vite.config.js), npm run build for production. No tailwind.config.js — Tailwind v4 via CSS import. Run npm run build after any Blade/CSS change.
test_framework: PHPUnit via php artisan test --compact. SQLite in-memory (phpunit.xml). All test files under tests/Feature/ and tests/Unit/.
verification_instructions: 1) php artisan migrate (new migrations run clean). 2) php artisan test --compact (all tests pass). 3) npm run build (exit 0). 4) php artisan route:list --path=orders (5 routes visible).
snapshot_or_generated_files: public/build/ (Vite manifest + compiled assets). Produced by npm run build. Do NOT commit public/build/.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Workspace root: e:\interview\BanglaPuzzle. Always use absolute paths. Run php artisan and vendor/bin/pint from e:\interview\BanglaPuzzle. Run vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent after every PHP file edit. Do NOT commit .env, vendor, node_modules, public/build, .agents/.
contribution_requirements: Always run vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent before finalising PHP changes. Create files with php artisan make: commands. Stick to existing directory structure. No new base folders without approval. Tests required for all logic changes.
key_patterns: Migrations: anonymous class, verbose foreign() syntax, decimal(10,2) or decimal(12,2), separate index() calls. Models: casts() method (not property), $fillable array, no empty __construct. Controllers: typed constructor DI, redirect()->with('success'/'error'), view() with compact(). Admin routes: prefix admin, name admin., middleware [auth, admin]. Customer routes: middleware [auth, customer]. Blade: x-admin.stat-card (label/value/subtext/iconBg/iconColor/iconPath), x-admin.page-header (title/createRoute/createLabel), x-badge (variant: emerald/red/blue/gray, text), x-empty-state (icon/title/description/actionLabel/actionUrl), x-alert (type/message). Image three-case rendering: str_starts_with($img,'http') ? $img : ($img ? Storage::disk('public')->url($img) : asset('images/placeholder.png')). Cart.getItems() returns [{id, name, price, oldPrice, image, url, category, qty}]. Flash: session('success'), session('error'). Admin sidebar active: request()->routeIs('admin.xxx.*') ? 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 font-semibold' : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100'. Checkout form @csrf is already inside the <form> tag.
directory_structure: app/Http/Controllers/ — storefront controllers (flat). app/Http/Controllers/Admin/ — admin controllers. app/Models/ — Eloquent models. database/migrations/ — sequential migrations. database/factories/ — one factory per model. resources/views/storefront/ — customer-facing Blade views. resources/views/storefront/auth/ — login/register/profile. resources/views/admin/ — per-resource subdirs (categories/, products/, orders/ to create). resources/views/layouts/ — admin.blade.php + storefront.blade.php. resources/views/components/ — global components (badge, alert, empty-state). resources/views/components/admin/ — stat-card, page-header. resources/views/components/storefront/ — breadcrumb, product-card. resources/js/app.js — Cart global object. tests/Feature/ — feature tests. tests/Feature/Admin/ — admin-specific feature tests.
